features.description: Fox Say is a separate iPad app target from Fox, sharing the WKWebView shell but using its own Bundle ID and default route.
features.handoff_relevance: prevents Fox Say from hijacking Fox while allowing a real iPad home-screen entry

features.description: FoxPad can record audio through a native iPad microphone bridge and upload it to the Fox API.
The Fox API stores capture metadata, exposes latest capture metadata, replays capture audio, and rejects empty captures.
The latest runtime capture can be exported to VCompose roundtrip storage without committing raw audio.
VCompose staged smoke consumes the exported real iPad capture and verifies existing Linux ASR/TTS evidence links.
One command validates latest capture, exports it to VCompose, submits the staged Linux smoke gate, polls the report, and writes a single local handoff summary.
Browser/iPad speechSynthesis can speak text, with Mandarin voice selection when available. It is explicitly not the natural Linux TTS target.
Fox Say can label latest captures into shape-only corpus sample manifests for the 50-100 real iPad/noise sample matrix.
features.handoff_relevance: starts real sample collection without admitting ASR text into workout state

features.description: Fox API can ingest Linux ASR results, create reviewable Fox drafts, and confirm them into voice-sourced Entries only after user review.
features.handoff_relevance: connects ASR text to Fox storage without allowing automatic workout state mutation

features.description: Fox Say can list pending voice drafts, select a draft, edit type/title/structured JSON, discard unwanted drafts, and confirm selected drafts into Entries.
features.handoff_relevance: turns staged ASR evidence into a daily usable review queue while preserving manual confirmation before storage

features.description: Fox Say now separates daily recording, local link testing, and draft inbox review so users can tell what stage they are in and whether a smoke path succeeded.
features.handoff_relevance: adds the UX layer needed before LLM extraction or realtime voice control

features.description: The latest iPad capture can be exported, transcoded to a Linux-friendly wav derivative, transcribed by SenseVoice on VCompose, and posted back to Fox as ASR evidence.
features.handoff_relevance: proves the staged iPad recording to Linux ASR to Fox draft path without realtime streaming or workout state mutation

not_features_yet.reason: streaming roundtrip latency is not measured
ASR text can become a confirmed Entry after manual review, but it is not admitted into the workout state machine
Linux TTS playback package exists, but automatic iPad playback is not wired
50-100 real human/iPad/noise samples have not been collected and scored
full realtime runtime, natural TTS playback, ASR command admission, UI polish, and benchmark evidence are not complete

allowed: UI/native team can build a better recorder UI on top of the native capture bridge
UI/native team can consume capture metadata and playback API
runtime team can consume exported captures in VCompose staged gates
blocked: do not claim realtime streaming is green
do not mutate workout state from ASR text without a new gate
do not market browser speechSynthesis as natural TTS
